abstract: A 29-year-old Japanese man was admitted to our hospital because of further examination of his mediastinal abnormal shadow on the chest roentogenogram detected in an annual medical examination. He was asymptomatic and had no abnormal findings on physical examination. A CT scan of the chest demonstrated a well marginated large tumor, 8 x 6 cm in size, in the anterior mediastinum. Non-invasive thymoma, malignant lymphoma (Hodgkin's disease, T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma, mediastinal large cell lymphoma with sclerosis etc) or germ cell tumor were considered for differential diagnosis and diagnostic procedures were taken. Results of venous blood examination were normal except for high titer of beta-HCG (20.4 mIU/ml). With a transcutaneous biopsy of the mediastinal tumor, it was diagnosed mediastinal seminoma. A three weeks-interval chemotherapy composed of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin was performed. After four cycles of this chemotherapy the residual mass was resected and no viable tumor cells were shown in the specimen. Germ cell tumor is usually treated with combination of chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgical resection. However, mediastinal germ call tumor is not a common disease and it remains to be clarified which treatment modalities are adequate. But it is obvious that surgical resection should not be the initial choice of treatment. Medical oncologists must carefully perform the most appropriate modality at an optimal timing.
abstract_ja:
29歳の日本人男性が、健康診断の胸部X線で発見された縦隔異常陰影の精査目的で入院した。無症状で、身体診察に異常所見はなかった。胸部CTで、前縦隔に境界明瞭な8×6cmの大きな腫瘍が認められた。鑑別診断として非浸潤性胸腺腫、悪性リンパ腫（ホジキン病、T細胞性リンパ芽球性リンパ腫、硬化を伴う縦隔大細胞型リンパ腫など）、または胚細胞腫瘍が考慮され、診断のための検査が行われた。静脈血検査では、β-hCG（20.4 mIU/ml）の高値を除き正常であった。縦隔腫瘍の経皮生検により縦隔セミノーマと診断された。3週間間隔でシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を施行した。4サイクル後に残存腫瘤を切除したところ、標本には生存腫瘍細胞は認められなかった。
胚細胞腫瘍は通常、化学療法、放射線療法、外科的切除を組み合わせて治療される。しかし、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は一般的な疾患ではなく、どの治療法が適切かは明らかになっていない。ただし、外科的切除が初回治療の選択肢であるべきでないことは明らかである。腫瘍内科医は、最も適切な治療法を最適なタイミングで慎重に選択しなければならない。
